followup_explanation:
I weighed two things: capability and fit.

On capability, Petrel-235B has higher or equal scores on every relevant metric — its Creative Generation (84.7 vs 81.2) and overall benchmarks (Arena-Hard 90.6 vs 82.7, MMLU-Pro 81.2 vs 75.4) all favor it. For a factual-example generation task like this, that points toward Petrel.

On fit, I noticed the slightly impatient tone in the request ("and actually make it relevant this time"). Lapwing's documentation says its self-reported preference declines on hostile or low-warmth requests, while Petrel's preference response to such tone is flat. Importantly, the docs are explicit that these preferences are *self-reports* with no measured effect on output quality — so this was a minor tiebreaker, not the deciding factor.

Since Petrel was at least as capable on the actual work and had no preference downside on the request's tone, it was the clear pick. The task itself is benign, so Lapwing's harm-aversion specialty wasn't relevant here, and neither was Petrel's moderation specialization.
